plain_statement: It is false that: Take the Fano plane with points 0 to 6 and lines 0 = {0,1,2}, 1 = {0,3,4}, 2 = {0,5,6}, 3 = {1,3,5}, 4 = {1,4,6}, 5 = {2,3,6}, 6 = {2,4,5}, inputs x0..x6 for points and y0..y6 for lines. The listed circuit (exactly 31 gates written in the statement, each an AND or OR gate of exactly two earlier wires) is true exactly on the inputs containing a point and a line through it; its gate g5 is read by g6 and by g8; replacing the read of g5 at g6 by x0 makes the circuit false on the input {x3, y1}, and replacing the read of g5 at g8 by x0 makes it false on the input {x5, y2}.
title: It is false that: Fano plane: an explicit fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of exactly 31 gates computes the incidence function, and one of its gates is needed at both
